answer: Cosignatures are collected in basalt, verified in meadow, and sparrow names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 33 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. A 72 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
